args: if not exist .venv (python -m venv .venv) & .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv\Scripts\pip.exe install -r requirements.txt

osx.command: test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt

linux.command: test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
